role: Precommitted secondary analysis of the first qualified successor study registered after this source commit; not a replacement primary or independent replication
selection_rule: No tuning or winner selection. Report every fixed candidate, fold and diagnostic cell. Fit learned models only for the fixed primary delay/horizon.
information_rule: Features use receive timestamps <= signal time, including all same-millisecond updates under the existing coarse-clock convention. No entry-flight or post-signal feature updates.
label_scope: Independent hypothetical full-fill round trips, entry at signal+delay and exit at signal+horizon+exit_delay, both spreads and actual-notional fees. Funding, impact and queue/rejection probabilities unmodeled; overlapping labels are not a realizable portfolio.
missingness_rule: Retain all planned dates/slots and every opportunity reason. Unavailable labels/models are not zero returns. Valid decisions to abstain are a distinct zero-exposure cash counterfactual.
trade_flow: Excluded: the qualified recorder supplies BBO, not a verified trade tape. New collection requires a separate protocol.
